Container.Name: jobagent
Container.Overview:
jobagent - an autonomous, employer-first job discovery agent for software engineers seeking roles in the Netherlands with employer sponsorship. It builds its candidate list directly from employers' own career systems (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, SmartRecruiters, etc.) - never from job aggregators - and checks every vacancy against the official IND public register of recognised sponsors.
Features: - Deterministic core: IND register indexing, ATS crawling, dedup, sponsorship classification and scoring - no AI required to build the list. - Optional AI (Claude/OpenAI/Gemini) for cover-letter drafting and re-ranking, behind configurable budgets and caching. - Evidence first: each vacancy carries a sponsorship category (1-5), quoted evidence sentences, salary-threshold calculations and source URLs. - No caps: every job above the relevance threshold is reported. - Safe application workflow: assisted mode by default; automatic submission requires explicit recorded authorisation and has a kill switch. - Respectful crawler: honours robots.txt and per-domain politeness delays.
Setup: - Mount a host directory at /data (e.g. /mnt/user/appdata/jobagent). All state - config, SQLite database, reports - lives there; it must be owned by UID 1000 (chown -R 1000:1000). - Run "jobagent init" once (with the same volume mounted) to create config and fetch IND data before the first scheduled run. - Scheduled runs fire daily via the built-in scheduler; override the command for one-shot runs (e.g. "jobagent run --catch-up"). - Publish port 8765 and run "jobagent dashboard --host 0.0.0.0" to use the web dashboard; prefer putting it behind a reverse proxy rather than exposing it directly.
